approvers: Owner/director; glazing subcontractor; client or developer
reason: The glazing sub is responsible for damage until handover, not me, so I have no budget line for this and I would have to convince the owner and the sub to pay for it. At around 19 euro a m2 on top of what we already do with cheap film and tape, it is hard to justify on small jobs.
objection: Damage to glazing before handover is the glazing subcontractor's problem and cost. Why would I add a new supplier and a 150 m2 minimum on a small house or block when film and tape cost almost nothing?
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, and keep telling the glazing sub to protect their own work and fix any damage.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a premium block that it cut snagging and callbacks by more than it costs, or the glazing sub or developer agreeing to pay for it so it is not our money.
